implementation_summary: Created IdentityPanel.tsx with: (1) AC-IDENT-1 — current device clientId + KP d-slot with copy-to-clipboard buttons, plus per-event relay info loaded from local IDB KPs; (2) AC-IDENT-2 — sibling slot list from relay-fetched kind-30443 events, each showing d_slot, latest_event_id, latest_created_at, relays_seen_on, and is_in_group derived from groupHasKeyPackageLeaf; (3) AC-IDENT-3 — plain-language 3-sentence explainer with no protocol jargon; (4) AC-OBS-2 — returns 'Not signed in' placeholder when client or pubkey is absent. Added Identity tab to SettingsModal.tsx alongside existing Connection and Devices tabs.

tests.note: UI-only story; no new unit tests required per spec. TypeScript compilation clean (npx tsc --noEmit produces no output).
